verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only unscoped automation credentials. A personal API key handles CLI authentication for automated workflows, and `bw serve` exposes the whole vault as a local API, which is the opposite of least privilege. Nothing documents issuing credentials limited to particular items, collections, or permissions for an agent, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
